title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
scope_boundary_zh: v2新增LRS-GRO训练禁用分支可有限纳入；不把v1权重型EO模型研发或v2其他训练分支改判为Harness，也不认定整篇都已共演化。
primary_reason_zh: v1明确harness是固定task环境，主要递归产物为EO模型权重，维持原exclude。v2新增training-free LRS-GRO：模型Qwen3-VL-8B冻结、禁止训练，agent迭代定位裁剪/示例检索/问题类型路由的code/text推理pipeline，由sealed verifier反馈选择并复制submission供9734题hidden test使用。此受限分支改的是模型外围执行方法并跨题保留，建议仅该分支纳Harness；传统EO网络训练和最后一个teacher脚本自动化不能单独证明agent自身Harness跨任务演化。
changes: 五benchmark变六，但并非只新增一项：移除Toulouse，新增Open-Canopy与training-free LRS-GRO。v1 Toulouse verifier/test gap20.2/17.5的负面记录仍属旧版，不应随版本替换悄然抹除。
v1要求全部submission深网必须agent训练，v2明确training-free例外只允许code/text；也放宽deep network为networks，并增加EO领域backbones。
generation从每次训练改为从之前模型输出训练的generation；外loop挑pipeline/内loopteacher-student仍以权重学习为主。
提交测试期限v1统一4小时，v2LRS-GRO允许8小时；查询verifier不设次数上限，验证集反复选择与最终test需区别。
新增三agent OpenEarthMap对照与局部validation描述；每task每agent只跑一次，跨模型排名不构成置信比较。
训练数据label预算只是任务harness配置由人设置，不是agent自改权限/validator；v2删v1 task-harness脚注不消除这一区分。

100–170美元/运行来自作者trajectory记载，4×12=48GPU小时是预算上限；没有本任务真实付费或账单关联。

evidence.quote: We use harness for this task-side environment. It is distinct from the agent harness, the scaffold that turns a language model into an agent.
on the training-free task, where no parameter may be updated at all and the submission holds only code and text.
Training-free adaptation removes trainable parameters from the harness, so the agent can only design how a fixed foundation model is used.
the agent answers with a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B without training any parameter.
On few-label LRS-GRO, it locates the region a question refers to, crops it from the full-resolution image and adds retrieved examples, which raises verifier accuracy by 4.4 points in a single step
the agent also routes each question by its type.
its final pipeline \pi^{\star} is evaluated once on a hidden test set with the same metric
Nothing else the agent created survives
Each task runs once per agent, and each agent score we report comes from that run.
The harness and the verifier of a task stay fixed

coverage: 对照v1/v2方法定义、全文范围/分析与附录，回读两版全部HTML语义表和v2图注；新分支没有复算原始轨迹或复现实验。参考文献与图二进制未逐项审。
